note: Seed prompt library for /banana inspire. Ships 2 curated prompts per category (40 total) as a real, usable starting set -- not the full 2,500+ referenced in SKILL.md. Expand by appending objects to `prompts` following the same schema; categories/modes below are the fixed vocab the filter script validates against.

prompts.title: Wind-blown runway backstage
prompts.prompt: A model in her mid-20s with sharp cheekbones and windswept auburn hair, wearing a structured oversized wool coat in camel over a black turtleneck, striding through a backstage hallway lined with garment racks. Fabric swings mid-motion, static flyaway hairs catching the light. Captured with a Canon EOS R5, 85mm lens at f/1.8, single hard strobe from camera-left casting a graphic shadow. Vogue backstage editorial.

prompts.title: Poolside silk, golden hour
prompts.prompt: A woman in her early 30s reclining on the tiled edge of an empty mid-century pool, wearing a bias-cut emerald silk slip dress, damp hair slicked back, one hand trailing in still water. Long late-afternoon shadows stripe the tiles. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 65mm lens at f/2.8, warm directional sunlight with a gold reflector fill. Wallpaper* design editorial.

prompts.title: Cargo bay maintenance
prompts.prompt: A weathered engineer in a scuffed orange EVA suit, helmet under one arm, standing in the cargo bay of a mining freighter, exposed conduits and hazard-striped catwalks receding into shadow. Steam vents from a pressure valve behind her. Captured with an ARRI Alexa, 24mm lens, deep teal ambient light cut by a single amber work-lamp. MUST show exactly one figure. A24 sci-fi production still.

prompts.title: Desert relay station at dusk
prompts.prompt: A squat concrete relay station bristling with satellite dishes, half-buried in red desert sand, dust devils spinning in the distance under a bruised violet sky with two visible moons. Captured with a Sony Venice, 35mm lens at f/4, blue-hour ambient light mixed with a warm sodium glow from a single station window. Denis Villeneuve-style sci-fi landscape.

prompts.title: Geometric monogram mark
prompts.prompt: A minimalist logo mark for a brand called "Nord & Vale": a monogram formed from two overlapping geometric triangles suggesting an N and V, rendered in a single deep forest-green, on a plain white background. Flat vector construction, even line weights, no gradients, no drop shadows, scalable icon-style design. MUST be a single standalone mark, no surrounding text.

prompts.title: Botanical wordmark badge
prompts.prompt: A circular badge logo with the text "Thistle & Ash" in a warm hand-drawn serif, arcing around the top of the circle, with a simple single-line illustration of a thistle flower centered below the text. Rendered in charcoal ink on a cream background, letterpress-style flat design, no photographic textures. Keep the text exactly as given and legible.

prompts.title: Amber serum bottle, studio glow
prompts.prompt: An amber glass dropper bottle labeled "VITA SERUM" in minimal white type, standing on a polished black acrylic surface with a soft reflection beneath it. Logo prominently displayed, facing camera. Backlit with a warm rim light separating the bottle from a graduated charcoal-to-black background, a few soft-focus water droplets on the surface nearby. Commercial beauty-product photography for an advertising campaign.

prompts.title: Sneaker mid-air with dust burst
prompts.prompt: A single white-and-terracotta running sneaker suspended mid-air against a flat clay-orange background, a burst of fine dust and chalk particles frozen around the sole as if just kicked off the ground. Logo prominently displayed on the side panel. Captured with a high-speed strobe, sharp product-catalog lighting from two sides, subtle drop shadow on the seamless backdrop. Nike-style commercial campaign shot.

prompts.title: Pour-over coffee, morning light
prompts.prompt: A ceramic pour-over dripper on a wooden stand, dark coffee streaming into a glass carafe below, steam curling upward, set on a walnut counter beside a single unglazed stoneware mug. Soft morning window light raking across the scene from camera-left, shallow depth of field blurring a potted herb in the background. Captured with a Canon EOS R5, 100mm macro lens at f/2.8. Bon Appetit feature spread.

prompts.title: Citrus cocktail, condensation and ice
prompts.prompt: A tall highball glass of a pale orange cocktail with condensation beading down the sides, one large clear ice cube, a curl of citrus peel resting on the rim, garnished with a fresh mint sprig. Backlit on a dark slate surface with soft bokeh from string lights behind, a few citrus wedges scattered nearby. Commercial beverage photography for an advertising campaign.

prompts.title: Executive headshot, soft studio
prompts.prompt: A man in his late 40s with graying stubble and a warm, confident expression, wearing a charcoal suit jacket over an open-collar white shirt, photographed against a seamless mid-gray backdrop. Soft octabox key light at 45 degrees with a subtle rim light separating him from the background. Captured with a Canon EOS R5, 85mm lens at f/2.2. Corporate executive headshot, natural skin texture retained.

prompts.title: Natural-light window portrait
prompts.prompt: A woman in her late 20s with freckled skin and a relaxed half-smile, wearing a cream linen shirt, seated beside a large window with sheer curtains diffusing soft daylight across her face. Baby hairs catching the light at her temple. Captured with a Sony A7R IV, 50mm lens at f/1.8, single source window light with a white bounce card camera-right. Candid lifestyle portrait.

prompts.title: Grizzled airship captain
prompts.prompt: A stocky steampunk airship captain in his 50s, weathered brass goggles pushed up on a leather flight cap, a thick gray beard, wearing a fitted burgundy coat with brass buttons and a fur-trimmed collar. Three-quarter view character turnaround pose against a plain neutral background, painterly digital illustration style with soft rim lighting. Concept-art character sheet, single figure, consistent proportions.

prompts.title: Forest guardian spirit
prompts.prompt: A slender, moss-covered forest guardian with antler-like branches growing from its head, glowing faint green eyes, and bark-textured skin, standing among ferns in a misty woodland clearing. Painterly fantasy illustration style with dappled light filtering through a canopy above, soft volumetric fog. Full-body character illustration, single figure, front-facing.

prompts.title: Fog-layered pine valley
prompts.prompt: A deep valley of dense pine forest with layers of morning fog settling between successive ridgelines fading into pale blue distance, a single shaft of sunrise light breaking through low clouds on the nearest ridge. Captured with a Nikon Z9, 200mm telephoto lens compressing the layers, atmospheric perspective strongly visible. National Geographic landscape feature.

prompts.title: Tide pools at blue hour
prompts.prompt: A rocky black-sand shoreline pocked with shallow tide pools reflecting a deep indigo blue-hour sky, gentle surf breaking softly in the middle distance, a few scattered starfish visible in the nearest pool. Long exposure smoothing the water, captured with a Sony A7R IV, 16mm lens at f/11 on a tripod. Fine-art coastal landscape photograph.

prompts.title: Brutalist stairwell, hard shadows
prompts.prompt: A monumental brutalist concrete stairwell with sharply angled geometric steps, raking midday sun casting hard graphic shadows across the raw concrete surfaces, a single small figure in a red coat crossing the middle landing for scale. Captured with a Fujifilm GFX100, 32mm lens at f/8. Wallpaper* architecture editorial.

prompts.title: Rain-slicked neon alley
prompts.prompt: A narrow city alley at night, wet asphalt reflecting overlapping pink and cyan neon signage from shopfronts on either side, steam rising from a street vent in the middle distance, a single figure with an umbrella walking away from camera. Captured with a Sony A7S III, 35mm lens at f/1.8, mixed neon color temperatures. Blade Runner-adjacent urban night photograph.

prompts.title: Fluid pigment bloom
prompts.prompt: An extreme close-up of deep indigo and burnt-sienna ink pigments blooming and swirling together in clear water, captured mid-diffusion in a marbled organic pattern, soft top-down studio lighting. Macro photography, fluid dynamics as the subject, no recognizable objects. Fine-art abstract print.

prompts.title: Geometric paper-light study
prompts.prompt: A composition of overlapping folded paper planes in cream, dusty rose, and sage green, lit from a low raking angle to emphasize crisp triangular shadows and soft gradients across each fold. Minimalist studio still-life, entirely geometric, no text or recognizable objects beyond the paper forms.

prompts.title: Quote card, editorial minimal
prompts.prompt: A social media quote card with the text "Small steps, every day" in a bold warm-cream serif typeface, centered on a solid deep terracotta background, generous margins on all sides. Flat minimalist graphic design, no photographic elements, high contrast between text and background for legibility. Keep the text exactly as given.

prompts.title: Product launch story teaser
prompts.prompt: A vertical Instagram-story-style graphic with the text "NEW DROP" in bold condensed white type at the top third, over a softly blurred lifestyle photo background of a hand holding a matte black skincare bottle, warm ambient light. Clear negative space reserved at the bottom third for a swipe-up call-to-action. Keep the headline text exactly as given.

prompts.title: Empty-state illustration
prompts.prompt: A friendly flat-vector illustration for an empty inbox state: a simple paper airplane resting on a small cloud, surrounded by a few small stars, rendered in a two-tone palette of soft periwinkle blue and white with clean rounded line art. Centered composition with ample surrounding negative space for UI text below.

prompts.title: Onboarding hero illustration
prompts.prompt: A flat-vector illustration of a diverse group of three small stylized characters collaborating around a floating oversized checklist, in a warm palette of coral, teal, and cream. Clean geometric shapes, consistent line weight, no gradients, designed as an app onboarding-screen hero image with clear space at the top for a headline.

prompts.title: Three-step process diagram
prompts.prompt: A clean horizontal three-step process infographic with the labels "Plan", "Build", "Launch" in bold sans-serif type, each step represented by a simple circular icon connected by a thin arrow, in a palette of navy, teal, and white on a light background. Even spacing, clear hierarchy, print-ready flat design. Keep all three labels exactly as given.

prompts.title: Annual growth bar chart
prompts.prompt: A minimalist bar chart infographic titled "Revenue Growth" showing four ascending bars labeled "2022", "2023", "2024", "2025" in a gradient from muted teal to bright teal, clean axis labels, generous white space, sans-serif typography throughout. Keep the title and all four year labels exactly as given.

prompts.title: Kraft-paper coffee bag mockup
prompts.prompt: A stand-up kraft-paper coffee bag with a matte black label reading "ROAST & CO." in warm cream serif type, a small line-art illustration of a coffee cherry branch beneath the wordmark, resealable zipper top visible. Photographed upright on a warm wood surface, soft studio side lighting, subtle shadow. Keep the label text exactly as given.

prompts.title: Minimalist skincare box set
prompts.prompt: A trio of matching rigid cardboard boxes in sage green with a single embossed leaf icon and the wordmark "VERA" in small letterpress-style type on each lid, stacked at slight angles on a pale plaster-colored surface. Soft top-down studio lighting, subtle embossing texture visible. Keep the wordmark text exactly as given.

prompts.title: Studio hero shot, three-quarter front
prompts.prompt: A matte deep-green electric hatchback photographed from a low three-quarter front angle in a cyclorama studio, gradient charcoal-to-black backdrop, a single sweeping rim light tracing the body panels and wheel arch. Logo prominently displayed on the grille. Captured with a Phase One XF, tilt-shift 40mm lens. Automotive commercial hero shot.

prompts.title: Coastal highway at dusk
prompts.prompt: A silver convertible sports car parked on a cliffside coastal highway overlook at dusk, headlights on, ocean and setting sun visible behind it, long exposure light trails from a passing car in the distant curve. Captured with a Sony A7R IV, 24mm lens at f/8 on a tripod. Automotive lifestyle campaign photograph.

prompts.title: Cliffside citadel at dawn
prompts.prompt: A vast citadel of pale stone spires built directly into a sheer cliff face, thin waterfalls cascading past its lower ramparts into mist far below, dawn light striking only the uppermost towers while the base remains in cool shadow. Painterly matte-painting style, dramatic atmospheric perspective. Concept art for a fantasy epic.

prompts.title: Ruined library under vines
prompts.prompt: The vaulted interior of an abandoned stone library, tall bookshelves collapsing under decades of creeping ivy, a single shaft of green-tinted light falling through a cracked domed skylight onto a pile of open, rotting books. Painterly digital matte style, moody and quiet. Fantasy concept art, no figures present.

prompts.title: Quiet morning ritual
prompts.prompt: A single hand resting beside a plain stoneware teacup on an otherwise bare linen tablecloth, soft diffused window light from one side, a folded newspaper barely visible at the edge of frame. Muted oatmeal and warm-white palette throughout, nothing else in the composition. Captured with a Fujifilm GFX100, 80mm lens at f/2. Quiet, minimalist lifestyle editorial.

prompts.title: Single chair, empty room
prompts.prompt: A single blonde-wood chair positioned in the center of an otherwise empty room with pale plaster walls, one tall window casting a long soft rectangle of afternoon light across the floorboards toward the chair. Nothing else in frame. Captured with a Hasselblad X2D, 45mm lens at f/5.6. Minimalist interior editorial photograph.

prompts.title: 1970s diner interior
prompts.prompt: The interior of a 1970s roadside diner, mustard-yellow vinyl booths, chrome-trimmed countertops, a jukebox glowing softly in the corner, warm incandescent light and a faint haze suggesting cigarette smoke. Shot on Kodak Portra 400-style film grain, slightly desaturated warm color cast, soft vignette. Nostalgic retro interior photograph, no figures present.

prompts.title: Mid-century poolside ad style
prompts.prompt: A woman in a polka-dot 1960s one-piece swimsuit and cat-eye sunglasses lounging on a mid-century vinyl pool chair beside a kidney-shaped pool, a portable transistor radio on the tiles nearby. Bright saturated Kodachrome-style color palette, hard sunny-day shadows. Vintage advertisement-style photograph.

prompts.title: Kitchen table confrontation
prompts.prompt: Two figures seated at opposite ends of a worn wooden kitchen table late at night, a single overhead bulb casting a tight pool of warm light while the edges of the room fall into deep shadow, a cold cup of coffee between them. Captured with an ARRI Alexa, 35mm lens at f/2, shallow depth of field, tense quiet mood. A24 drama film still.

prompts.title: Departure at the station
prompts.prompt: A lone figure with a single suitcase standing on an empty train platform as a train pulls away in the background, steam and motion blur trailing off the last carriage, cool blue pre-dawn light with a single warm platform lamp overhead. Captured with a Sony Venice, 50mm lens at f/2.8, anamorphic-style flares. Cinematic drama still, wistful mood.

prompts.title: Zen mid-century platform bed
prompts.prompt: A serene bedroom viewed from the doorway at a three-quarter angle: a low platform bed with a solid walnut frame and a channel-tufted olive-green upholstered headboard, dressed in a warm terracotta linen duvet and layered sage-green and chocolate-brown velvet pillows. A single hand-brushed enso circle in soft charcoal ink hangs above the headboard with generous negative space. A tatami-inspired herringbone-weave rug in tone-on-tone oatmeal anchors the floor. Walnut nightstands with round terracotta ceramic lamps flank the bed; a tan leather sling chair and a tall potted fiddle-leaf fig sit in the window corner. Muted, warm, uncluttered atmosphere. Captured with a Canon EOS R5, 24mm lens at f/5.6, soft midday light. Wallpaper* design editorial, Kinfolk magazine mood.

prompts.title: Warm minimalist reading corner
prompts.prompt: A quiet bedroom corner styled for reading: a low wood-framed daybed with a single wool throw folded at the foot, positioned beside a floor-to-ceiling window dressed in a simple linen roman shade. A round rattan side table holds one ceramic mug and a small stack of books. Bare oak flooring transitions into a solid warm-clay wool rug beneath the daybed. Soft, indirect afternoon light, no overhead fixtures on, deliberate negative space on the walls. Captured with a Fujifilm GFX100, 45mm lens at f/4. Minimalist interior editorial photograph, calm and uncluttered.
